name: Hamza Tahir
headline: Founder of ZenML. AI engineer working on agents and ML in production.
summary: I'm the founder of ZenML, an open-source AI platform that takes teams from ML pipelines to agents. What I think about most is getting agents and ML systems to work in production: evals, orchestration, and what breaks once real users arrive. If you're working on the same problems, I'd like to hear about them.

open_to.notes: Conversations with people working on agents in production, evals, or machine learning in production. Bring a real problem you're working on.
